I'm trying to deploy my first shiny app in shinyapps.io

How could I overcome this?

messages.subject: Re: shinyapps Error in checkEncoding2(file) : could not find function "isWindows"
parts:
Are all of your packages up-to-date? Try update.packages(ask = FALSE)
then devtools::install_github('rstudio/shinyapps')

If it still gives you the same error, please report

library(shiny)
library(shinyapps)
sessionInfo()

Regards,
Yihui
